effect.name: GM Pixel Drift
effect.desc: Block-coherent digital displacement with deterministic animated phase control.
effect.shader: float pnkjPixelRand(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*43758.5453);}void main(){vec2 u=acScreenNorm;vec2 sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec2 cell=floor(u*sz/max(blockSize,1.0));float a=pnkjPixelRand(cell+floor(phase));vec2 o=vec2((a-0.5)*2.0,pnkjPixelRand(cell+floor(phase)+19.7)-0.5)*distance/sz;vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,u);vec4 d=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(u+o,0.0,1.0));gl_FragColor=mix(s,d,clamp(mixAmount,0.0,1.0));}
